subject: Workplace Skills
title: Building a Reputation Inside Your Company
description: Learn Building a Reputation Inside Your Company in one minute.

hook.text: Her external brand was strong: 10K LinkedIn followers. But internally, her own teammates didn't know her best work.

buildup.text: Internal branding matters for promotions, project assignments, and protection during layoffs.

discovery.text: Present at team meetings, volunteer for cross-functional projects, and share insights in internal channels.

twist.text: Internal reputation spreads through stories. One memorable project narrative travels further than a dozen status.

climax.text: Be known for one clear thing internally: the person who fixes hard problems, connects teams, or simplifies complexity.

punchline.text: Known for one thing internally. Make it count.

quiz.question: How do you build a strong internal reputation?
options: Focus exclusively on your external brand and online presence
Be known for one clear strength through projects and cross-functional visibility
Send frequent emails to leadership about your achievements
